# Data Providers

Clients for the external data sources, in `src/common/providers/`, and the fetch stage that uses them. See [Data Processing](../pipeline/data-processing.md).

#### MapillaryClient.fetch()

```python
def fetch(
    bbox: BoundingBox,
    fields: list[str],
    limit=MAX_IMAGES_PER_REQUEST,
    min_quality: float | None = None,
)
```

Fetch image metadata for every Mapillary image in bbox.

If min_quality is set, images whose quality_score is below it are
skipped (images with no score are kept). quality_score must then be
in fields.

[source](https://github.com/Qualcomm-MDP/PSM/blob/main/src/common/providers/mapillary.py#L83)
